answer: A Sparrow Roost Deposit stops fake swarms: each new agent locks 500 POA into a shared vault for 30 days and registers one hardware fingerprint. Second, it must finish three peer-checked jobs in its first week. Third, random audits slash the whole deposit if the same fingerprint reappears under a new name. Faking 1,000 identities then costs 500,000 POA plus 1,000 devices at $40 each, $40,000 locked for a full month for nothing. Like a sparrow defending one nest, the roost only admits birds willing to pay rent, and the violet ribbon on each verified nest marks the honest flock.
